text:
maya (Marketing): Hey team — planning a coordinated release announcement for the v1.4 rollout next Wed. Need: changelog link, canonical docs link, exact rollout timing, webinar date, and inbound lead routing. Can we sync here? :megaphone:
aj (Eng): Changelog PR merged this morning: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/3a7b9f2 — main bullets: 30% lower gen latency, streaming + function call improvements, new quantization profiles.
Canary starts Tue 06:00 PT, staged ramp to 50% by 09:00, full at Wed 12:00 PT. We'll post status updates during the ramp.

kelly (Docs): Docs draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v1.4 — PR #411 is in review, expect merge by EOD today. I'll add a "what's new" section and migration notes for quantization.

sam (Product): Are there any breaking changes or config migrations customers need to know about? Need a short copy we can put in the release banner.

aj (Eng): No hard-breaking changes. Quantization defaults changed for new model variants — customers using custom quant configs will see different perf; we should call out "no action required for most users" and link to migration snippet. Migration snippet: `CONFIG.quant_profile = "v2-default"`

nate (PR): For press/blog: can we get an embargoed blog draft by Tue morning? Also need a short exec quote. Maya, can you draft the blog outline and I’ll craft the press note?

maya (Marketing): Yes — I'll have the blog outline + draft by Mon EOD. For the webinar, proposed Thurs 11:00 PT: "Faster, Cheaper Inference — v1.4 launch". Panel: aj + sam + kelly. Thoughts? :calendar:

aj (Eng): Thurs 11:00 PT works for eng. We can demo live canary traffic metrics and a short walkthrough of the quantization UI.

kelly (Docs): I'll prepare a 10-min "how to upgrade" doc section for the webinar deck and add links to code samples.

maya (Marketing): Lead routing: plan is to route inbound demo/webinar signups + blog CTAs to Marketing SDR queue, tag as `launch_v1.4`. Nate — do you want a separate PR funnel for press leads?

nate (PR): Yes — press/media leads go to me directly (nate@redwood.ai). For high-touch enterprise inbound (trial requests flagged as >$5k ARR potential), route to enterprise-sales@redwood.ai and notify sam. We should include UTM params: `utm_campaign=v1.4_launch`

sam (Product): I'll confirm the enterprise threshold and add a rule to the routing doc. Also want the changelog bullet copy for the release banner: short 1-liner we can use across channels.

maya (Marketing): Draft banner copy: "Introducing v1.4 — 30% faster generation, streaming improvements, and new cost-saving quant profiles. Learn more → [docs link]" — happy to iterate.

aj (Eng): That reads well. Add a parenthetical about non-breaking: `(no action required for most integrations)`

deploy-bot (CI): Deployment scheduled: canary start 1763696400 (Tue 06:00 PT). Notifications will post to #release-war-room.

maya (Marketing): Perfect. Action items recap: I'll deliver blog draft + banner copy by Mon EOD; Kelly merges docs PR today; Aj confirms canary + status updates; Nate prepares press note + routing; Sam finalizes enterprise routing rule. If everyone OK, we'll lock messaging by Tue 09:00 PT so assets can be scheduled. :white_check_mark:

aj (Eng): 👍 will post a short changelog snippet for the blog (2-3 bullets) in this thread by EOD.

kelly (Docs): Merging docs now, will post final docs URL here after merge.

nate (PR): I'll draft the press note template and share with maya for tone edits.

maya (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll follow up with calendar invites for webinar and a short launch checklist in this thread.

sam (Product): Thanks — leaving a note to double-check SSO customers on the upgrade path.

maya (Marketing): Ok closing loop for now — ping here with any last-minute changes. :rocket:
